findings.title: The deploy job runs on every push to main with no test or check before it
findings.evidence: `.github/workflows/deploy.yml:8`: the deploy job has no `needs:`. `/sdlc:sdlc-audit`: Gate partial, Test missing.
findings.fix: Add a test job and make the deploy job wait for it (`needs: test`). `/gate:gate-init` sets up the gate.

findings.title: Decide whether main takes direct pushes or only pull requests
findings.evidence: 34 of 40 commits on main in 90 days were direct pushes.
findings.fix: Write the choice as an ADR with `/decisions:adr`, then set the branch rule to match.
